Messages.Author: Brian Reed
Messages.Body:
I have a question about Troile's Revenge. The Ventrue with this card on it
must hunt every turn. Is this considered a "mandatory action" in the same
sense that Lunatic Eruption is? I ask because it's been ruled that after
hunting, all mandatory actions must take place, but the errata on Troile's
Revenge state that the action to remove Triole's revenge can happen before
the Ventrue must hunt.

Please clarify,
Thanks
-Brian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Hmm. Old ruling, I guess.
I'll clean that up.
The mandatory actions must be taken first.
